# Landometer Design System 0.9.6
Current version: 0.9.6. Color Set: color-srgb-09. Package: v0.9.6-owner.1 (owner-approved, unsigned).
- [Human and machine reference](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/)
- [Brand DNA, Voice and Visual playground](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/#play)
- [Full Implementation Library](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/#implementation-library)
- [Current complete Color Atlas](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/#complete-color-atlas)
- [Standalone approved color-scale explorer](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/color-atlas.html)
- [Canonical source](https://github.com/montri-th/Landometer/tree/main/plugins/landometer-design-system)
- [Release](https://github.com/montri-th/Landometer/releases/tag/v0.9.6)
Use exact bundled assets. Retain brand voice/visual from 0.9.1. Do not use historical color-srgb-05 or inherited color-srgb-07 for a new unpinned artifact. Explicitly pinned older projects retain their release until migration. Package verification is not universal output conformance. Team account activation is separate from local installation.
Website build ui-20261001-lds096-r1 retains the full 0.9.5 handbook with fourteen owner-approved three-color sequential families. Light sequential ramps begin with cream #F2F1DF; each midpoint is a distinct hue. Density remains warm for all denominators. Diverging scales, categorical colors, brand voice, identity, motif/animation and shared atmospheres are unchanged.

- [Project Source setup and separate product Add-ons](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/project-source-0.9.6.md)
- [Archived 0.9.5 guide and assets](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.5/)
